# Shelby Web Company
> Local web design, SEO, branding, and custom digital solutions for service businesses in Shelby, NC and surrounding Western North Carolina communities.


Website: https://www.shelbywebco.com/  
Phone: (704) 473-8188 (call or text 24/7)  
Email: dave@shelbywebco.com  
Location: Shelby, NC (serving Cleveland, Gaston, Rutherford counties including Gastonia, Kings Mountain, Forest City, Boiling Springs, and Polkville)


## Overview
Shelby Web Company is a non-exclusive local agency founded by Dave Richardson. We build custom, hand-coded websites, local SEO systems, branding, and "business machines" (custom software and automation) specifically for local service businesses. 20+ years of IT and network engineering experience. CompTIA A+ certified. Formerly Studios by Dave. Trusted by 100+ local businesses. 5.0 Google rating.


## Core Services
- Custom web design & development (Astro, modern performance-first stack)
- Local SEO, technical SEO, and AI search visibility (GEO)
- Google Business Profile optimization & review generation
- Logo design, branding & audio branding
- Custom software / SaaS / business automation ("Business Machines")
- STRAT Console — our proprietary SEO analytics and reporting platform
- Ongoing website care plans


## Pricing (transparent)
Three growth plans. Every plan has a **six-month initial term, then continues month-to-month** — cancel any time with 30 days' written notice. Cancelling before six months carries a $297 early cancellation fee.

- **Core — $497 launch + $297/month** (6-month initial term · 6-month total $2,279)
- **Plus — $798–$998 launch + $597/month** (6-month initial term · 6-month total $4,380) — most popular
- **Ultra — $998–$1,498 launch + $797/month** (6-month initial term · 6-month total $5,780)
- **Website Care Plan (standalone, no SEO subscription) — $497 build, then $149/month** — web hosting and SSL, automated backups, security monitoring and updates, small monthly edits and content changes, core code and plugin updates
- Free logo design with any full web package
- Free SEO audit for selected local businesses
- $100 referral bonus, repeatable


## What Each SEO Plan Actually Does
These are the same three plans, described by the SEO work performed.

- **Core ($297/month)** — technical SEO health check (crawlability, indexation, sitemap, robots.txt); on-page optimization on priority pages (titles, metas, headers, internal links); Core Web Vitals and mobile speed fixes; Google Business Profile setup, categories and attributes; structured data / schema markup on core pages; local citation and NAP consistency clean-up; keyword rank tracking in STRAT Console; monthly performance snapshot and quarterly growth review. Best for local businesses that need a correct, solid foundation but are not ready for aggressive growth work yet.
- **Plus ($597/month)** — everything in Core, plus keyword and competitor research every month; new service/location content each month; review-generation system and review replies; GBP posts, photos and Q&A management; ongoing local citation building; link acquisition and digital PR outreach; conversion-rate fixes on top landing pages; AI-visibility tracking (llms.txt and AI answer inclusion); milestone audits every 90 days. Best for businesses ready to invest in real local visibility and consistent inbound leads.
- **Ultra ($797/month)** — everything in Plus, plus a full content program (2–4 pages/month plus refreshing decaying content); off-page link building and authority campaigns; landing-page CRO testing; lead tracking and attribution (calls, forms, bookings); follow-up workflows and automation; dedicated growth manager and priority support; advanced analytics, custom dashboards and multi-location reporting; milestone audits every 90 days. Best for businesses that want SEO, lead generation, and conversion handled as one system under one roof.


## Who We Serve
Local service businesses including roofing, landscaping, solar installers, home remodelers, concrete/construction, plumbers, tree services, expedited trucking, and similar trades. We welcome any business that needs help — we are non-exclusive.
